scripts.predev: node scripts/check-dependencies.mjs && node scripts/dev-port-guard.mjs && node scripts/setup-shadcn-ai.mjs && node scripts/setup-ripgrep.mjs && npm run dev:tools
scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && cd TinadecGateway && bun run build && cd .. && node scripts/dotnet.mjs build TinadecOffice.slnx --no-restore
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && cd TinadecGateway && bun test && cd .. && node scripts/dotnet.mjs test TinadecOffice.slnx --no-build
scripts.restore:dotnet: node scripts/dotnet.mjs restore TinadecCore/TinadecCore.slnx && node scripts/dotnet.mjs restore TinadecOffice.slnx
scripts.diagrams: d2 --layout tala --sketch --theme 0 --dark-theme 200 --pad 40 docs/diagrams/boundary.d2 docs/diagrams/out/boundary.svg && d2 --sketch --theme 0 --dark-theme 200 --pad 40 docs/diagrams/dual-layer.d2 docs/diagrams/out/dual-layer.svg && d2 --sketch --theme 0 --dark-theme 200 --pad 40 docs/diagrams/roadmap.d2 docs/diagrams/out/roadmap.svg
scripts.ai:tools:install: npm i -g @colbymchenry/codegraph && codegraph telemetry off && codegraph install --target=opencode --location=local --yes
scripts.ai:tools:check: npm run ai:codegraph:status && npm run ai:ponytail:validate
